name: gantt-chart-visual
description: Atlyn Gantt Chart for Power BI

scripts.test:visual:build: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('.tmp',{recursive:true})" && npx lessc style/visual.less .tmp/visual-harness.css && npx esbuild test/visual-harness-entry.ts --bundle --outfile=.tmp/visual-harness-bundle.js --format=iife --target=es2020 --loader:.less=empty
scripts.test:visual: npm run test:visual:build && npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:visual:update: npm run test:visual:build && npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.validate:certification: npm audit --audit-level=moderate && npm run eslint && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test && npm run test:visual && npm run package
